about: Prompts for the monster generator's eval (server/ai.js). Tags: [CR band, how the CR is given, then features]. expect.count is how many monsters the request asks for (the generator makes one when it doesn't say); expect.cr is the CR it names, when it names one CR for all of them. Cases tagged caster will mostly grade 'unsure' (evals/balance.js can't judge spells) and are there to see what the generator does with them.
